body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> LG Electonics (www.lge.com) unveiled 'Revolution', the smartphone supporting 4G LTE, at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'Revolution' was made in collaboration with Verizon, mobile communication enterprise which has started LTE service in America and adopted Android 2.2(Froyo) as basic platform.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
